chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all together from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام), who said:

When Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) was taken, al-Hasan ibn Ali (عليه السلام) stood in the Masjid of Kufa. He praised Allah, extolled Him, and sent salat upon the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), then said: O people, in this night a man has been taken away whom the former ones did not surpass, nor will the latter ones reach. He was indeed the bearer of the banner of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله); on his right was Jibra'il and on his left was Mika'il. He did not turn back until Allah granted victory to him.

By Allah, he left behind neither white nor red, except seven hundred dirhams remaining from his stipend, with which he wanted to buy a servant for his family. By Allah, he was taken in the night in which the legatee of Musa, Yusha‘ ibn Nun, was taken, and the night in which Isa ibn Maryam was raised up, and the night in which the Qur'an was sent down.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam Ali (عليه السلام)
key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the Qur'an, whose sending down is mentioned in connection with that night
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il, the angel mentioned as being on his right
key_terms.رَايَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the banner of the Messenger of Allah, indicating his leadership in battle
key_terms.سَبْعَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: seven hundred dirhams, the small amount he left behind
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ: the Mosque of Kufa, where Imam al-Hasan (عليه السلام) delivered this address
key_terms.مِيكَائِيلُ: Mika'il, the angel mentioned as being on his left
key_terms.وَصِيُّ مُوسَى: the legatee of Musa, referring to Yusha‘ ibn Nun

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hasan (عليه السلام) say after the passing of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report describes the sermon of Imam al-Hasan (عليه السلام) after the martyrdom of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (عليه السلام), proclaiming his unmatched virtue, divine support in battle, and ascetic life. It also links the night of his passing with sacred moments associated with earlier divine legatees and the sending down of the Qur'an, highlighting his unique spiritual rank in sacred history.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> stood up in Masjid Al-Kufa. So he<sup>asws</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Extolled upon Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and send Salawat upon the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, then said: O you people! He<sup>asws</sup> has passed away during this night, a man (the likes of whom) has not preceded among the former ones nor will he be among the later ones. He<sup>asws</sup> was the bearer of the flag of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. Upon his<sup>asws</sup> right was Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>, and on his<sup>asws</sup> left was Mikaeel<sup>as</sup>. He<sup>asws</sup> was not deterred until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Granted victory to him<sup>asws</sup>.

By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He<sup>asws</sup> neither left behind a white nor a red, except for seven hundred Dirhams, being an excess from his<sup>asws</sup> gifts. He<sup>asws</sup> intended to buy a servant with it for his<sup>asws</sup> family. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He<sup>asws</sup> has passed away during the night in which the successor<sup>as</sup> of Musa<sup>as</sup> Yoshua Bin Noun<sup>as</sup> passed away, and the night in which Isa Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup> was ascended with, and the night in which the Quran was Send down’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salma ibn al-Khattab from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad from ‘Abdallah ibn al-Qasim from ‘Isa Shalqan who has said the following.

“I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) has maternal uncles in tribe of descendant of Makhdhum and a young man from them came to him (Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and said, “Uncle, my brother has died and I am very sad because of his death.” The narrator has said that he asked him, “Do you want to see him?” He said, “Yes, I want to see him.” He said, “show me his grave.” The narrator has said that he (Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) came out with him with the gown of the Messenger of Allah on him and when he reach the grave he moved his lips and knocked his grave with hid foot and he came of his grave speaking in Persian language. Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) asked, “Did you not die as a Arab man?” He said, “ Yes, but we died in the tradition of so and so son of so and so then our language changed.”
